fieldSemantics.riskCodeByDecendio: Raw non-zero values from dec1–dec36. The consulted dictionary defines decêndios as planting periods but does not define the numeric risk-code legend; therefore these values are not labelled as percentages in this artifact.

note: Rows for maize intercropped with brachiaria document the consortium system only; they do not establish an independent Urochloa ruziziensis planting window. This dataset does not by itself enable a recommendation.
